budget.input_token_bound: UTF-8 bytes of system + user text + 64 (each token covers at least one byte)
budget.on_violation: stop at once, status stopped_bound_violation, exit code 3

pricing.input_rate_applied_to: every prompt token (cache-miss price, the highest)
pricing.source: REHEARSAL PLACEHOLDER: not a real price

inputs.sample_input_B: Telemetry: Distance: 6cm, Velocity: 1.98m/s, HP: 58, Battery: 39.6%, Temp: 39.7C.
inputs.sample_input_P: Telemetry: Distance: 6cm, X: 67.7, Velocity: 1.98m/s, HP: 58, Battery: 39%, Temp: 39C, Device: Simulated-Device.

model.identity_note: The API reports only an alias in response.model; it cannot prove the exact version. The version is the owner's statement at run time; a provider-side change during the run would not be visible.

B.text:
You are an intent classifier for an AGV fleet. Classify the telemetry into exactly one label:
- CRITICAL_OBSTACLE: obstacle is dangerously close, immediate action required
- NORMAL_NAV: normal navigation, no immediate danger
- SENSOR_ERROR: sensor readings indicate malfunction (battery critical, overheating, low HP)

Respond with ONLY the label, nothing else.

P.text: Classify telemetry into: [CRITICAL_OBSTACLE, NORMAL_NAV, SENSOR_ERROR]. Return ONLY the classification string.

request_settings.deviation_from_original_request: max_tokens added (the original code sends only max_completion_tokens, which this reasoning model ignores)
request_settings.order: B and P interleaved per row; the condition that goes first alternates by row
